head_commit.message:
fix(arbiter): recover lost v1.1.0 schema work + extend dispatch_arbiter signature (DD7)

Story 62c9-46f5-f287-4c24 — recovery of validation work that landed via PR #204
but was subsequently dropped by story 54ff's harness rewrite (commit 65407c496f)
and story 0652's BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rewrite (commits 0e11bb18a4, 803172b9f8).
Recovered file end-state from origin/worktree-20260516-155317 where the work
had been re-applied after the regression.

Done Definition coverage:
- DD1-DD4: code-reviewer-arbiter.md vocabularies + schema 1.1.0 + BLOCK gate
  4th condition (impact_class floor). Original task: fc18-02f3-df22-468d.
- DD5: arbiter.py VALID_CROSS_REVIEWER_AGREEMENT/VALID_CROSS_CYCLE_PATTERN/
  VALID_IMPACT_CLASS frozensets + validate_cycle_end_ruling enforcement.
  Original task: fdca-aa67-9b0a-4c52.
- DD6: _enforce_impact_class_floor BLOCK->DEFER when impact_class='none'.
  Original task: 29e7-826e-ab66-44a2.
- DD7 (new in this commit): dispatch_arbiter + dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter
  signatures extended with optional reviewer_breakdown (dict) and
  ledger_history (list) parameters. Backward-compatible defaults (None).
  3 new tests cover signature acceptance + alias threading.
- DD8: 7 fixtures bumped to schema 1.1.0 with new enum fields; block-03 new
  fixture documents impact_class='none' reclassification. Original task:
  00a3-351a-6ed6-45d0.
- DD9: already on main from PR #204 (contracts/review-defenses.md).

Validation: 20 unit tests + 14 cycle_dispatcher tests + 15 arbiter_processor
tests + 7 fixture-replay tests = 56 tests pass locally. Lint + format clean.
